guide.title: How to use WordSplitter
guide.intro: WordSplitter cuts one Word document into two files at a page boundary. Your original file is never modified.
guide.steps.title: Four steps
guide.step1: Select a .docx file. WordSplitter counts its pages with Microsoft Word.
guide.step2: Enter Page A and Page B. The cut falls midway between them.
guide.step3: Name the two new files and choose where to save them.
guide.step4: Press Split. Both files are checked before they are saved.
guide.rule.title: Where exactly is the cut?
guide.rule.body: File 2 starts at the page right after the midpoint of A and B. When the midpoint is a whole page, that page stays in File 1.
guide.example: A = {a}, B = {b}: File 1 gets pages 1–{end1}, File 2 starts at page {start2}.
guide.sample.title: Try it with a sample
guide.sample.body: Create a 12-page practice document and do a real split with Page A = 6 and Page B = 7. File 1 will hold pages 1–6 and File 2 pages 7–12.
guide.tips.title: Good to know
guide.tip1: Microsoft Word for desktop must be installed. It runs hidden, and only while a task is running.
guide.tip2: Save your document in Word first. WordSplitter reads the saved file, even while it is open in Word.
guide.tip3: Page numbers follow Word on this computer, so look them up in Word on the same PC.
guide.tip4: Update fields such as a table of contents after splitting: press Ctrl+A, then F9.
sample.title: WordSplitter practice document
sample.page_body: This is page {n}. In the practice split, Page A = 6 and Page B = 7, so the cut falls between page 6 and page 7.
sample.goes_file1: After the split, this page belongs to File 1.
sample.goes_file2: After the split, this page belongs to File 2.
err.not_docx_ext: Only .docx files are supported. Files ending in .doc, .rtf, .odt or .pdf can't be split.
err.not_found: The file can't be found. It may have been moved, renamed or deleted.
err.not_a_file: The selected item isn't a file.
err.in_use: The file is locked by another program or access was denied. Close it there and try again.
err.not_zip: This isn't a valid .docx document. Open it in Word and save it as a Word Document (.docx).
err.encrypted_or_legacy: This file is password-protected or is an old .doc file renamed to .docx. In Word, remove the password or save it as a Word Document (.docx), then try again.
err.zip_corrupt: The document is damaged. Open it in Word, save a new copy, and try again.
err.zip_missing: The document is incomplete. Open it in Word, save it again, and try again.
err.page_same: Page A and Page B must be different pages.
err.page_out_of_range: {label} is {value}, but the last page of the document is {total}.
err.single_page: This document has only one page, so there is nothing to split.
err.split_out_of_range: With these pages the cut would fall outside the document. Choose other pages.
err.name_only_ext: {label} needs a name, not only an extension.
err.name_trailing: {label} can't end with a space or a period.
err.name_reserved: {label} uses a name that Windows reserves: {name}
err.name_too_long: {label} is too long. Use at most {max} characters.
err.names_same: File 1 and File 2 would get the same name. Choose two different names.
err.name_is_source: {label} is the same as the original file's name. Choose a different name.
err.output_path_too_long: The folder path plus the file name is too long. Choose a shorter name or another folder.
err.dest_missing: The save folder doesn't exist anymore. Choose another one.
err.dest_readonly: WordSplitter can't save in this folder. Choose another folder. If Windows Security has Controlled folder access turned on, allow WordSplitter there.
err.disk_space: There isn't enough free disk space. Needed: {needed_bytes}. Available: {free_bytes}.
err.source_changed: The document changed after it was checked. It is being checked again; please confirm Page A and Page B.
err.word_missing: Microsoft Word couldn't be started. Install Microsoft Word for desktop (2016 or later, or Microsoft 365) and open it once to finish activation.
err.word_open: Microsoft Word couldn't open the document. It may be damaged or protected.
err.word_blocked: Microsoft Word stopped to show a message ({title}) and was closed. Open the document in Word yourself to see what it needs, then try again.
err.word_crashed: Microsoft Word stopped unexpectedly. Please try again.
err.word_pagination: Microsoft Word couldn't count the pages of this document.
err.doc_restricted: This document is restricted against editing. In Word, turn off Review › Restrict Editing, save, and try again.
err.cut_failed: Word couldn't remove the part of the document beyond the cut. Try a different pair of pages.
err.empty_part: With these pages one of the files would be empty. Choose other pages.
err.save_failed: Microsoft Word couldn't save one of the new files.
err.verify_failed: {label} didn't pass the final check, so nothing was saved.
err.both_full: Both new files still contained the whole document, so the split was stopped. Nothing was saved.
err.commit_failed: {label} couldn't be saved as {name}. The file may be open in another program.
err.worker_crashed: The background task stopped unexpectedly. Nothing was changed.
err.unexpected: Something unexpected happened. Nothing was changed.
err.sample_failed: The sample document couldn't be created.
warn.pages_differ: Page count of {label}: {actual} (expected {expected}). The layout shifted slightly at the cut, so please check the file.
warn.fields_unlinked: A field that crossed the cut, such as a table of contents, was turned into plain text.
warn.identical: Both files turned out byte-for-byte identical. Please check them.
warn.delete_failed: The original file couldn't be removed. Both new files were saved.
